sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you take damage.
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Barrier

system.description:
You create a small explosion from the palm of your hand, timed to deflect incoming damage, capable of bounding ranged attacks back. Reduce the triggering damage by 4d6.

If the triggering damage was the result of a ranged attack from a creature you can see, you deflect some of it back. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack targeting the attacking creature. On a hit, you deal 2d6 force damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage reduced and the damage dealt by 1d6.
